classification: Natural fresh-boot MAME 0.281 observation of the exact compiled larger-replacement image using the existing tracked physical coin/start replay. Boundaries come only from native debugger breakpoints; the Lua periodic callback is the stopped-state driver. No save/load state, PC/register/RAM seed, debugger write or synthetic state injection.

supervisorAcceptance.note: This record documents a completed worker capture and offline audit; it does not assert supervisor acceptance or publication.

mame.version: 0.281 (hash-pinned; -version not launched to preserve the single fresh capture boundary)

sampleContract.source: input.lua emu.register_frame_done rows with native debugger-stop callbacks
sampleContract.classificationRule: A row is real_60hz when its emulated time is within one eighth of the known 60 Hz frame period of the derived grid. An off-grid start-active row is accepted only when it is contiguous with the real 60 Hz start rows, matches the ordered recorded phase/session stop time, and equals the recorded native phase debugger stop count. Any other off-grid active row is rejected.

verificationGap.note: The raw capture is not rerun. Any observer/checker change after capture is reported as a verification gap, not substituted for the captured bytes.

mameRecord.description: One fresh-boot larger-replacement MAME observation at native boundaries with the existing tracked physical coin/start replay

parentResult.note: The larger callee exit is 0001. The naturally observed successor 75A9 normalizes positive 0001 to 0000. This task does not claim the parent result or downstream gameplay.

dp.note: DP was sampled directly from cpu.state["DP"] in every stopped-state snapshot. The raw value (0) and its explicit 8-bit normalization (00, mask 00FF) were recorded for every phase. The installed 0.281 state entry exposed only .value, not a numeric width property, so dpWidthBits is recorded as unknown and no width is fabricated. This is a measured DP value with an honestly unavailable width attribute, not a static deduction.

limitations: MAME success is not physical MPU4 hardware compatibility.
The seventeen map phases are static address/stack contract inputs validated against live execution; the map predictions are not themselves measurements.
The optional post-75A9 successor is a separate explicit contract beyond the seventeen static map phases.
The callee exit 0001 is observed, but 75A9 normalizes positive 0001 to 0000; the parent result and downstream gameplay are not claimed.
Only the single larger replacement reached from the naturally observed 9F14 caller site is claimed.
The broader purpose of the 9F12 caller and all downstream consumers remains unresolved.
H is not defined, output or asserted; CC values are recorded as diagnostics only.
No paid-gate, full-game or hardware claim is made.
DP was sampled directly, but the installed 0.281 state entry did not expose a numeric DP width; the width is recorded as unknown and the value is normalized with 00FF, never fabricated.
